title: GUP manifest message
description: Publishes the capability vocabulary a domain speaks. Every other party (validator, renderer, orchestrator) validates against it.

version.description: The manifest (vocabulary) version documents are validated against.

expression.description: Identifier of the expression dialect used by gate/derive/read (e.g. 'jsonata').

namespaces.description: Declared namespace roots available in the Store.

actions.description: Available action families: the six built-ins plus any declared custom actions.

propsSchema.description: JSON Schema for this capability's props.

emits.description: Event names this capability can emit.

slots.description: Structural slots (child regions) this capability accepts.

dataProp.description: Which prop receives bound data from a read edge (e.g. metric -> "value", table -> "rows"). Defaults to "value".
